in_sanskrit.name: Kushraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessing, Prosperity, Prince
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kushraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kush: Prosperity, Happiness, Blessing Raj: Ruler, Prince This name is derived from the Sanskrit words Kush and Raj, meaning 'Blessing, Prosperity, Prince'. It is a powerful and meaningful name in Hindu tradition.
